test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

Saira is unable to sustain friendships because she always __has too many axes to grind__.

options.text: To have one's own interests to serve

solution:
The correct answer is **__To have one's own interests to serve__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **idiom **is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words
 
• The meaning of idiom **has too many axes to grind** is to hold a strong personal viewpoint on something.
 
• *Example *: He has no political **axe to grind**, he is just concerned about the state of affairs here.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some more **idiom **are :

 
• **Hit the sack** - go to sleep

*Example *:I am so tired that I am going to **hit the sack** as soon as I am home.

 
• **On cloud nine** - being very happy

*Example *: After scoring so good I feel like being **on cloud nine.**

 
• **Left out in the cold** - being ignored

*Example *: Jack was **left out in the cold **when Mia met Jim.
